hooks.command: bash -c 'echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); f=d.get(\"file_path\",\"\"); exit(0 if any(f.endswith(e) for e in [\".gd\",\".tscn\",\".tres\"]) else 1)" 2>/dev/null && echo "[docs-keeper] Code file modified: $CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" >> /tmp/aok_docs_trigger.log || true'
